svg.title: DorkOS systems and deployment boundaries
svg.desc: The DorkOS client reaches a local execution server. Community has its own browser, server and storage. The local server participates in approved Community channels through qualified HTTP and SSE. Cloud is optional. The website and local installer both read marketplace sources.

div.style: color: rgb(24, 48, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
